title: Provisions
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 1.79 Linked Discourses 1.79
  • 8. Chetvāvagga 8. Slain

Pātheyyasutta Provisions

“Kiṁsu bandhati pātheyyaṁ, “What binds the provisions for a journey? kiṁsu bhogānamāsayo; What’s the vault of wealth? Kiṁsu naraṁ parikassati, What drags a person around? kiṁsu lokasmi dujjahaṁ; What in the world is hard to give up? Kismiṁ baddhā puthū sattā, With what are ordinary beings bound, pāsena sakuṇī yathā”ti. like birds in a snare?”

“Saddhā bandhati pātheyyaṁ, “Faith binds the provisions for a journey. sirī bhogānamāsayo; Majesty is the vault of wealth. Icchā naraṁ parikassati, Desire drags a person around. icchā lokasmi dujjahā; Desire in the world is hard to give up. Icchābaddhā puthū sattā, Ordinary beings are bound by desire, pāsena sakuṇī yathā”ti. like birds in a snare.”
